outputs.title: Settings › Outputs
outputs.subtitle: Available structured output types
outputs.available_sub: Lumen can return different structured output types depending on the tool or action that produced the result. When connectors return StructuredOutput objects, they will appear here.
outputs.empty_sub: Outputs will appear here when tools return typed results.
outputs.type_text_desc: Plain text response. Default format for conversations.
outputs.type_document_desc: Structured document in Markdown or HTML. Ideal for reports and documentation.
outputs.type_notification_desc: Notification with level (info, warning, error). For system alerts.
outputs.type_web_desc: Renderable HTML content. For embedded dashboards and interactive views.
outputs.type_image_desc: Generated or retrieved image. Supports URL or base64.
outputs.type_plot_desc: Chart in JSON format (matplotlib/plotly). For data visualization.
